sloka: किमाह सीता हनुंस्तत्त्वतः कथयाद्य मे ।एतेन खलु जीविष्ये भेषजेनातुरो यथा ।। ५.६६.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: kimāha sītā hanuṁstattvataḥ kathayādya me ।etena khalu jīviṣye bheṣajenāturo yathā ।। 5.66.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman Tell me now truly what has been told by her. I am eager to know. Indeed, it will keep me alive just as medicne does. (I shall survive on the strength of her message)
translations.hindi: जो हो, इस समय, मेरा यह सबस्त्रदान रूप आलिङ्गन ही महात्मा ( महाबली) हनुमान जी के कायं के योग्य पुरस्कार हो
